items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions David Bowie in the context of Carlos Alomar's work history ('He only talks about having worked with David Bowie'). Kenny Barron does not mention David Bowie, nor does he claim any personal or professional relationship with him.

ctx.x: When you mention – of course, any pianists coming through your lessons and your tutelage are going to benefit greatly. You mentioned folks like Terence Blanchard. There’s David Sanchez.
So, what are those folks – are you actually showing them piano? Because I know when we studied, it was more independent study. We were going over history, stylistic development, and things like that.
